title: What If Every Bee Disappeared? Your Bread Would Survive, Your Coffee Wouldn't

scenes.text: What if every bee vanished tomorrow? Your bread would survive. Your coffee wouldn't.
About 75 percent of the crop types we grow depend on pollinators to some extent. Very few depend on them completely.
Maize, wheat and rice do not need bees at all. Neither do cassava, peas or lentils.
But cocoa, coffee, apples, avocados, kiwi and melons would drop, some of them a lot.
Pollinators support about 35 percent of global food production by volume. Yields could fall roughly 5 to 8 percent overall.
Not famine. Something quieter: a diet with far less fruit, fewer vegetables and nuts, and a lot more bread.

description:
What if every bee disappeared? About 75 percent of crop types depend on pollinators to some extent and they support about 35 percent of food production by volume.
Staples like wheat, rice and maize do not rely on them, but fruits, nuts, coffee and cocoa would suffer, and global yields could fall roughly 5 to 8 percent according to a 2009 analysis.
